title: Sources: Anthropic met behind closed doors with House Homeland Security and discussed issues like export controls, only briefly touching on its DOD fight (Maria Curi/Axios)
summary: Maria Curi / Axios: Sources: Anthropic met behind closed doors with House Homeland Security and discussed issues like export controls, only briefly touching on its DOD fight — - The discussion focused largely on issues like model distillation — shrinking powerful AI systems into smaller versions — and export controls.
